description: This file declares interfaces and constants related to WAN (Wide Area Network) mode management, including function prototypes for initializing, configuring, and querying WAN modes, as well as related event handling. It also includes license information and header guards.

methods.name: system_module_loaded
methods.description: Checks if the system module for WAN management is loaded.

methods.name: update_sensing
methods.description: Updates sensing information related to WAN modes.

methods.name: wan_mode_init
methods.description: Initializes WAN mode configurations and states.

methods.name: get_wan_manager_obj
methods.description: Retrieves the WAN manager object instance.

methods.name: get_physical_type_by_reference
methods.description: Gets the physical type based on a reference string.

methods.name: get_physical_type
methods.description: Returns the physical type of a given WAN mode object.

methods.name: wan_mode_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup for WAN mode management.

methods.name: wan_mode_dm_set
methods.description: Sets WAN mode using device management.

methods.name: wan_mode_set
methods.description: Sets the WAN mode with specified operation mode.

methods.name: wan_mode_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific WAN mode.

methods.name: get_wan_mode
methods.description: Retrieves a WAN mode object by its alias.

methods.name: get_current_wan_mode_str
methods.description: Returns the current WAN mode as a string.

methods.name: wan_manager_found_ll
methods.description: Handles discovery of a WAN manager based on physical type.

methods.name: _update_autosensing
methods.description: Internal callback to update autosensing based on an event.

methods.name: _update_sensing_policy
methods.description: Internal callback to update sensing policy.

methods.name: _wan_sensing_toggled
methods.description: Internal callback for toggling WAN sensing.

methods.name: _ipv4_mode_toggled
methods.description: Internal callback for toggling IPv4 mode.

methods.name: _ipv6_mode_toggled
methods.description: Internal callback for toggling IPv6 mode.

methods.name: wan_mode_convert_from_str
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a mode to its enum form, considering IP version.
